scalars.scalar_value: Experience with Ellucian Colleague and Ethos.

items.item_text: 01. Please describe any experience supporting an ERP systems environment with such applications as human resources, financial aid, student records, and/or a financial system that includes payroll. What was the computer platform? Discuss your experience with troubleshooting and analyzing system effectiveness and/or failures. (Limit your response to 300 words.)

02. Share your experience as a project leader for software and systems development, including supervising and training programmers, as well as communicating with and training end-users. (Limit your response to 300 words.)
03. Please describe your programming experience, including applications, languages, and software used. (Limit your response to 300 words.)

04. Describe your training and experience with the following, being specific about languages, packages, and versions used: a) Fourth generation languages. b) RDBMS administration. c) Tools for data retrieval and reporting, including ad hoc, custom, and canned queries. d) Database analysis, design, and support. e) MS SQL systems administration. f) ERP systems administration and integration with 3rd party vendors. g) Web-based applications and integration. h) Mandated federal and state reporting requirements.
05. Please provide an example of a successful systems development project with which you were involved and outline the steps taken to make it a success. (Limit your response to 300 words.)

06. Describe your experience working with or serving individuals from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and race/ethnic backgrounds and what you learned from the experience.? Give specific examples. (Limit your response to 300 words.)
Experience with Ellucian Colleague and Ethos.
Experience with both data reporting and data integrations between systems.

Administers applications and operations for functional areas of the college (e.g. finance, human resources, student, financial aid, etc.) for the purpose of ensuring availability of services to authorized users.
Coordinates with other IT professionals at the college (e.g. cross-training, scheduling, etc.) for the purpose of ensuring cross-functionality and IT coverage for the college.
Designs a variety of programs (e.g. reports, queries, software interfaces, etc.) for the purpose of ensuring effective and efficient use of the acquired software applications.

Maintains software applications for functional areas of the college (e.g. business applications, student records software, software upgrades, interface scripts, report generation, etc.) for the purpose of ensuring efficient operations under the college's standards.

Manages assigned projects and program components (e.g. applications interfaces, updated applications software, etc.) for the purpose of delivering web-services in compliance with established guidelines and objectives.

Participates in a variety of planning and development activities (e.g. long-term plans, required updates, new applications, etc.) for the purpose of providing information to support web needs and requirements for the college.
Prepares written materials (e.g. procedures, system level documentation, reports, etc.) for the purpose of documenting activities, providing written reference, and conveying information.
Provides user training and support for the purpose of functioning as a project leader for software development.

Recommends equipment, supplies, and materials (e.g. applications software that meets system requirements, migration to updated software, etc.) for the purpose of acquiring required items and completing jobs efficiently.
Researches a variety of work-related topics (e.g. trends, products, equipment, tests, etc.) for the purpose of recommending procedures and purchases.

Responds to inquiries from a variety of sources (e.g. staff, administrators, college personnel, outside vendors, service providers, etc.) for the purpose of providing technical assistance and support.
Troubleshoots malfunctions (e.g. incorrect information generated from queries, software bugs, etc.) for the purpose of resolving operational issues and restoring services.
Performs other related duties as assigned for the purpose of ensuring the efficient and effective functioning of the work unit.
MS SQL systems administration, including SSRS and SSIS.
Knowledge of modern API-based integrations, workflows and tools (Javascript, JSON, Postman, etc).
